settings.text: Answers about O&M orders, shipping, returns, and product care.

settings.heading: What is your return window?
settings.answer: O&M accepts unworn returns within 30 days of delivery. Items should have original tags attached. Start a return from your order confirmation email or the contact page.

settings.heading: How long does shipping take?
settings.answer: Most orders leave the warehouse in 1–2 business days. Domestic delivery is typically 3–7 business days after dispatch. International orders can take 7–21 business days depending on customs.

settings.heading: How much is shipping?
settings.answer: Shipping rates are calculated at checkout based on your address and order size. Free-shipping thresholds, when offered, appear in the cart drawer.

settings.heading: How can I track my order?
settings.answer: A tracking number is emailed as soon as your O&M parcel ships. Use that link for live carrier updates.

settings.heading: Will I pay customs?
settings.answer: International duties are set by your local customs office. If charges apply, they are the customer’s responsibility and are not collected by O&M at checkout.

settings.heading: How do O&M pieces fit?
settings.answer: Most tees and tops are a relaxed streetwear fit. Check the size guide on each product page. If you are between sizes, size up.

settings.heading: How should I wash my order?
settings.answer: Turn garments inside out, wash cold, and hang dry. High heat can fade prints and shrink fabrics.

settings.heading: Where are your products made?
settings.answer: O&M works with small-run apparel partners. Origin can vary by drop and is listed on the product page when available.

settings.support_text: Email hello@oandm.com or use the contact form. We typically reply within one business day.
